meta.name: Hello Stranger
meta.description: Two strangers meet in South Korea, each on a vacation.  When he misses his tour bus, he asks a woman if he can hang out with her for a few days. They have fun together, but never tell each other their names.  So when the trip is over they don't know how to contact each other.
meta.slogan: One city. two strangers. An unlikely love story.
